Method of Attack: Hijacking legitimate sites to act as makeshift command and control (C2) servers to inject and hide credit card skimmers on targeted eCommerce sites
Injecting malicious JavaScript snippets into target commerce sites that fetch skimmer code from compromised legitimate websites
Obfuscation of skimmer code using Base64 encoding and mimicking popular third-party services like Google Tag Manager or Facebook Pixel
Stealing customer PII and credit card details via CSS selectors and exfiltrating data using HTTP requests embedded as IMG tags with Base64 encoding
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in digital commerce platforms or third-party services used by websites
Compromise of legitimate websites to host malicious code as C2 servers
Injection of malicious JavaScript snippets into target eCommerce sites
